title: Interview with Professor Ingrid Vos
date: 2026-05-08
author: Ingrid Vos
---
Q: When did you last see the violin?
A: I put the violin back in the vault at 5 PM and locked it. I headed out at about 5:10 PM.
Q: And in the morning?
A: I came in at 7:55 the next morning and the case was empty.
